gaps.quote: every guard value occurs equally often
gaps.note: The page asserts that, with the spectators fixed, every guard value occurs equally often, so a guard is bad with probability 20/2^{K-1}. Its only justification is that spectators are the coordinates the addition leaves unchanged. The reader cannot check why the guard values are uniform, and the page never says that addresses play the role of the outcome set Omega with uniform choice, which the union bound requires.

gaps.quote: The bound holds without [Independence of events](independence.md) between the events.
gaps.note: The page states that the counting-form union bound holds without independence but gives no argument for it. The worked example checks one instance only, so the reader cannot verify the general claim from the page.
